g.title: workflows
g.text: Blocked ≠ running · parked routes are unselected · thesis STOPPED

a.xlink:title: Selected project-local skills and workflow deliverables integrated and working against the agreed support contract, with evidence and caveats retained; all assignments closed and their sessions released. Plans alone do not establish readiness. Thesis execution remains STOPPED. blocker: Selected completion package and acceptance criteria are not agreed; delivery, acceptance and session release remain unfinished. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md

Coordinator presents consolidated alternatives, expected outcomes, resource estimates, limitations and precise activation/acceptance scope. Jörn selects migration/knowledge scope and substantial expenditure; retain/defer is a valid explicit disposition. blocker: Returned proposals and completed route/accounting recommendations need coordinator integration into one reviewable package; Jörn has not selected its scope, substantial expenditure or acceptance criteria. plan_gap: No complete selected implementation/acceptance package exists. Proposal estimates are not authorization; readiness must not silently mean every proposed feature or pilot. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md, docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md, AGENTS.md.commentary.md

Integrate the selected project-local skills, discovery adapters and other concrete workflow deliverables; retain explicitly accepted deferrals for additional capabilities. Assign owned implementation steps and checks after selection. Plans alone cannot close delivery. blocker: No implementation/activation package selected; selected communication acceptance is unfinished. Dashboard/map delivery is complete; historical transport cause can remain unknown. plan_gap: Implementation owners, concrete change list and receiving/review responsibilities must follow selection. This placeholder does not authorize migration, evaluations or host/cloud setup. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md, docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md

Verify bounded message/return delivery for the selected workflow paths, or retain a specifically accepted limitation. Native bounded worker send/return delivery succeeded in this window; legacy independent-session send receipt remains unverified. blocker: Required communication paths and their acceptance contract have not been selected; native packet delivery does not establish legacy MCP send recovery. plan_gap: Native subagent send/return worked. Original independent-thread endpoint failure cause lacks evidence; current read connectivity does not prove sends or receipt. Select whether retained-file/manual receipt suffices or a bounded live send/ack test is required. Sources: docs/development-environments.md

Check selected artifacts and relevant client/environment routes, retain unavailable checks and behavioral limits, and obtain review of the resulting bounded readiness claim. No full thesis checks are implied. blocker: Selected acceptance criteria and delivered candidate are absent. plan_gap: Fresh Codex/Claude discovery and selected remote handoff/review checks are unperformed. A behavioral pilot is optional until selected; structural checks alone do not establish reliable behavior. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md, docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md, docs/development-environments.md

Coordinator integrates outcomes, records any pending decisions with a receiving owner, closes completed assignments and releases their sessions. Do not confuse an idle planner with an active owner. blocker: Coordinator integration and selected workflow delivery/acceptance remain unfinished; bounded worker assignments have ended. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md

Separate coordination, browser views and reusable knowledge Canonical coordination and browser source contract complete; five HTTP checks passed. Prior Chrome inspection unavailable. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md, docs/coordination/thesis-work.md, docs/coordination/handoff.md
Route process knowledge into project collaboration guidance Local collaboration rules and knowledge routing complete; link/state checks passed. Behavioral and post-compaction performance untested. Sources: AGENTS.md, AGENTS.md.commentary.md, docs/knowledge/README.md
Set up authorized workstation-only OpenObserve telemetry Live workstation logs/traces/metrics API-verified after daemon restart. Host implementation complete; maintenance belongs to ~/.dotfiles/INSTALL.md. Browser login unverified. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/otel-design.md
Prepare repository-owned skill migration Reviewable local skill/discovery migration proposal returned; planner assignment ended. Candidate, activation and fresh-client acceptance remain unselected. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md
Plan process-knowledge cleanup and behavioural evaluation Reviewable two-link cleanup and bounded forward-pilot proposal returned; planner assignment ended. Cleanup and pilot remain unselected. Sources: docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md
Review and consolidate returned skill and knowledge proposals Reviewed migration and knowledge proposals against returned environment/accounting findings. Recommend nine project-local skills with Claude adapters, conditional host capabilities and retained-packet handoffs; defer controlled behavioral pilot and new messaging infrastructure. Concrete package selection remains Jörn’s decision; no skill activation or execution approval is inferred. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md, docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md
Remaining workflow dependencies visible in the dashboard Dashboard exposes goal, unfinished dependencies, planning gaps and parked routes; native-width graph has a goal-centered viewport. Local desktop and 390px mobile reviews passed; phone graph requires panning. Source/path/HTTP checks passed. Coordinator owns integration. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md
Define support and handoff routes across selected environments Read-only supported-route matrix returned: local .agents source plus proposed Claude links/import; retained packets and manual host handoff initially. Independent-thread live delivery and SSH persistence remain unverified; Codex Cloud privileged-image/R2 bootstrap assumptions are not validated for Claude. plan_gap: Claude fresh-clone setup/discovery, cloud-to-host handoff, remote-device review access and reconnect/session continuity have no agreed acceptance route. Required support versus explicitly deferred capabilities is unresolved. Sources: docs/development-environments.md, docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md
Define truthful usage and spending observations Read-only recommendation returned: current.json and retained outcomes own durable PM state; OpenObserve is diagnostic. Optional explicit packet-event JSONL-to-OTel helper only if selected; no broker/database. Token/time observations are not billing; quota/USD unknown and independent-root/cloud usage is not covered. plan_gap: Comparable cloud/Pro usage, semantic task/message journaling and budget-enforcement mechanics are undefined. Numeric thresholds are not agreed; the selected delivery may explicitly defer automation. Sources: AGENTS.md.commentary.md, docs/development-environments.md
Completion map and graph projection retained Goal/dependency map retained in canonical JSON with explicit planning gaps and parked routes; DOT/SVG project shared state with a source-hash drift check. Syntax, missing-dependency/cycle rejection, stale DOT/SVG detection and state/path checks passed. Coordinator owns integration and subsequent refresh. Sources: docs/coordination/README.md

Determine why agent communication tools failed Bounded local diagnosis finished. Same daemon persisted through failures; multiple TUI MCP server processes turned over. Stale endpoint binding is plausible, but old-port ownership, shutdown/rebind evidence and original cause are unavailable. Current list verifies reads only. blocker: Historical endpoint ownership/binding evidence is unavailable; current successful reads do not establish original cause or legacy send recovery. plan_gap: Capture failing URL, socket owner/PID and endpoint-binding lifecycle events on the next natural failure. Do not launch repeated investigation or restart the shared daemon. Sources: docs/coordination/current.json
Optional local skill candidate, activation and fresh-client tests Proposed nine-skill local package, Claude discovery adapters and focused acceptance route. Keep outside loaded paths until selected. This is a candidate route, not an assignment. plan_gap: Initial instruction was inspect/plan/discuss first; migration and activation selection absent. Sources: docs/coordination/skill-migration-plan.md
Optional knowledge cleanup and forward pilot Choose retain-and-observe, two-link cleanup only, or cleanup plus bounded A/E pilot. No model calls or cleanup are launched by this plan. plan_gap: Scope, owner and resources have not been selected; broader cases and post-compaction validation remain unperformed. Sources: docs/coordination/knowledge-evaluation-plan.md
Possible cloud communication, setup and accounting automation External surfaces remain outside workstation telemetry. Live cloud messaging, detailed returned event logs and enforcement are possible mechanisms; required support and value are undecided. plan_gap: No agreed need, design, acceptance contract or authorization for cloud automation. Sources: docs/development-environments.md
Thesis execution — STOPPED Previous thesis completion run remains stopped. Backlog availability does not authorize a new execution window. Sources: docs/coordination/handoff.md
